articles.description: The newly-elected Speaker is Matan Kahana, an ally of Gadi Eisenkot, the party leader currently working to form the next government and replace Mr. Netanyahu

articles.headline: Secretary of State Marco Rubio says no information links technical outages to malign actors.
articles.title: Marco Rubio says ‘zero’ information that U.S. outages are linked or caused by a malign actor
articles.summary: United States Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated on November 17, 2026, that there is no evidence connecting recent technological failures across the country to malicious actors or cyberattacks. The service disruptions affected Microsoft, JPMorgan Chase, air traffic control systems, and a National Security Agency network. While corporate and government entities attributed the issues to internal upgrades or software bugs, the repeated failures triggered widespread public skepticism and demands for government transparency.
articles.description: President Donald Trump faced a groundswell of criticism as friends and foes alike said the White House must answer for a cascade of service outages that snarled travel, cut off work, limited bank access and disrupted classified communications

articles.headline: CCMB scientists identify new strategy to prevent fungal infections from becoming invasive
articles.title: CCMB study points to new way of tackling fungal infections
articles.summary: Researchers at the CSIR-Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology in Hyderabad discovered small molecules targeting sugar metabolism that block Candida albicans from forming filament-like structures. Published in ACS Infectious Diseases, the study found the compounds keep the fungus in a harmless rounded form without killing it directly, improving survival rates in a mouse model and offering a potential alternative to traditional antifungal resistance.
articles.description: Fungi can gradually develop resistance to current antifungal drugs, making infections increasingly difficult to treat

articles.headline: Indian seafarer missing following vessel attack in Strait of Hormuz
articles.title: Indian national missing after attacks on commercial vessel in Strait of Hormuz
articles.summary: One Indian national is missing and two others were injured after their Panama-flagged LPG tanker MT Tara Gas came under attack in the Strait of Hormuz on November 16, 2026. According to the Ministry of External Affairs, 21 of the 24 Indian crew members were safely evacuated to Khasab. New Delhi condemned the incident, emphasizing that ongoing assaults on shipping lanes threaten seafarer safety and must cease immediately.
articles.description: MEA said that of the 24 Indian nationals on board MT Tara Gas, 21 have been safely evacuated

articles.headline: Delhi Police defend male officers handling women in crowd control
articles.title: No mandate only women personnel can ‘handle’ women in crowd-control operations, Delhi Police to SC
articles.summary: The Delhi Police informed the Supreme Court that deploying only female officers for crowd control is not a statutory mandate, responding to petitions regarding the manhandling of female protesters and journalists. In an affidavit, authorities stated that using male personnel depends on operational considerations, while adding that content creators are not legally classified as working journalists.
articles.description: The police said it was yet to be determined if “reel-makers can be elevated to the status of journalists or reporters”.

articles.headline: Congress-led UDF government in Keralam marks six months in office
articles.title: Six months of Keralam UDF govt: is the administration lumbering or hitting the ground running?
articles.summary: The Congress-led United Democratic Front government in Keralam marked six months in office on November 18, 2026, prompting debates on whether the administration has expedited its transformative vision for development and welfare or if it is still strolling as promised by Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan.
articles.description: As the government enters its sixth month in office on November 18, the question hovering over the polity is whether the ruling alliance’s actions have matched its soaring rhetoric about expediting a transformative vision for Keralam’s development and welfare

articles.headline: Ships risk Hormuz Strait due to limited US protection
articles.title: Ships risk Hormuz Strait due to limited US protection
articles.description: Elisabeth Braw with the Atlantic Council says US navy cannot protection to every vessel passing the Hormuz Strait.

articles.headline: Thomas Markle charged with child sexual abuse material in Philippines
articles.title: Philippines police ask prosecutors to charge Thomas Markle over child sex abuse material
articles.summary: Philippine police filed charges against Thomas Markle Senior on Monday for possessing and intending to distribute child sexual abuse material. Prosecutor Graeme Elmido confirmed the development following the discovery of seized devices from Markle's former residence. Currently held in the United States after a separate arrest by the Federal Bureau of Investigation, Markle has previously denied all allegations.
articles.description: Markle is being held in custody in the US after one charge and has previously denied all of the allegations.

articles.headline: Russian military transport plane crashes in western Siberia, killing nineteen people
articles.title: Russian military transport plane crashes in Siberia, killing 19: Defence Ministry
articles.summary: An Antonov-12 military transport aircraft crashed in western Siberia on November 17, 2026, resulting in the deaths of all nineteen people on board according to the Defence Ministry. The incident occurred in an unpopulated area near Kemerovo, with preliminary findings indicating equipment failure as the cause. Emergency responders extinguished a resulting fire near the village of Yagunovo while the Investigative Committee launched a formal inquiry.
articles.description: The An-12 aircraft went down in an unpopulated area near the city of Kemerovo, about 3,000 kilometres (about 1,860 miles) east of Moscow

articles.headline: UK transfers detained US soldier accused of Russia spying to America
articles.title: U.K. hands NATO-assigned American soldier accused of Russia spying to U.S.
articles.summary: British police transferred Lieutenant Colonel Brandon Tyner, a forty-one-year-old American soldier stationed with the North Atlantic Treaty Organization, into United States military custody following espionage allegations. Counter Terrorism Policing confirmed the handover occurred after an extensive investigation into suspected national security violations. The Kremlin denied any links to the detained officer.
articles.description: A U.S. Army official has named the detained soldier as 41-year-old Lieutenant Colonel Brandon Tyner

articles.headline: Jay Shah reappointed unopposed as International Cricket Council chairman
articles.title: Jay Shah reappointed unopposed as ICC Chairman for second term
articles.summary: The International Cricket Council announced on November 16, 2026, that thirty-eight-year-old Jay Shah was reappointed unopposed for a second two-year term. The decision was finalised during board meetings ending November 15, 2026, to provide leadership continuity as cricket prepares for its return to the Olympics at the 2028 Los Angeles Games.
articles.description: Jay Shah took over in December 2024 and was reappointed during the global body's Board Meetings that ended in Bali

articles.headline: Andhra Pradesh deploys disaster response teams for Cyclone Akvan
articles.title: Andhra keeps 13 NDRF and 11 SDRF teams ready for Cyclone Akvan
articles.summary: Andhra Pradesh Home Minister Vangalapudi Anitha announced that 13 National Disaster Response Force teams and 11 State Disaster Response Force units are positioned for emergency relief operations regarding Cyclone Akvan. Officials reviewed preparedness on November 18, 2026, directing agencies to remain on high alert as heavy rainfall is anticipated across coastal districts.
articles.description: People can call 112, 1070 or 18004250101 in an emergency, and report power cuts, fallen trees and waterlogging on WhatsApp at 95523 00009
